description: Owner sees six vague attention cards: MESSAGE_BACKLOG, three indistinguishable WORKTREE_PROBLEM, ONE-DISK RECOVERABILITY and duplicate unacknowledged message count. Show human-readable problem, owning agent, branch/path, severity and actual consequence. Deduplicate the same message queue, group worktree issues by identity, distinguish normal ahead/unique commits from broken operations or unprotected work. Non-owner approvals must not gain approve buttons. No generic dismiss, mass acknowledgement, automatic merge/cleanup or silent remote push. Actions must preserve drafts under refresh and report pending/error/unknown honestly. Full-audit completion is no longer an implementation-start prerequisite; actual browser desktop/mobile visual acceptance remains required before completion. Scope: separate Waiting on you (genuine authenticated owner decision with consequence/options), Fleet handling (named responsible domain and next step), and Arbiter handling (provider starts/install activation). Do not rewrite the dashboard architecture or hide unresolved risks. QA path consent is required before assignment; existing frozen assertions, ownership and verification controls remain enforced.
